name: Qlik MCP
description: Explore Qlik Cloud apps, query chart data, build sheets and charts, and manage glossaries and data products from your LLM through Qlik's MCP server.

skills.name: App Discovery
skills.description: Searches Qlik Cloud apps, data products, and datasets and describes an app's fields, sheets, and data model before you query it.

skills.name: Data Exploration
skills.description: Queries chart data, searches fields, applies and clears selections, and analyzes the results like an analyst inside a Qlik app.

skills.name: Sheet And Chart Building
skills.description: Creates apps, sheets, charts, and master dimensions and measures in Qlik Cloud from prompts in your MCP client.

skills.name: Script And Reload Management
skills.description: Reads and updates app load scripts, starts and cancels reloads, and fetches reload status and logs for a Qlik app.

skills.name: Business Glossary Management
skills.description: Creates glossaries, categories, and terms, updates term status, and links glossary terms to data assets in Qlik Cloud.
